# Ashiwani Kumar — Linux DevOps & SRE Engineer

> Personal portfolio of Ashiwani Kumar, a Linux DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer based in Abu Dhabi, UAE, with 7+ years running mission-critical infrastructure. Currently managing infrastructure for 5 UAE airports (50M+ annual passengers) at 99.9% uptime, plus an ongoing deployment at Muscat International Airport, Oman.

Key facts:
- Role: Linux DevOps Engineer at Astek Middle East (Jan 2024 – present), Abu Dhabi, UAE
- Focus: Kubernetes, OpenShift, AWS, Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps, cloud migration
- Track record: 7+ years in production, 500+ servers managed, 99.9% uptime across aviation, healthcare, and telecom
- Aviation: critical systems for Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and other UAE airports; on-site work at Muscat International Airport (Oman, ongoing)
- Previous: System Engineer at NMC Healthcare (UAE), Linux System Administrator at CoreHive Computing (India), SUSE Linux & VMware Admin at Dilip Buildcon (India)
- Certifications: AWS Solutions Architect – Associate, RHCSA, CCNA, JNCIA (Cloud, SEC, Junos)
- Education: B.E. Computer Science Engineering, RGPV University (2015–2018)
- Open source enthusiast; interested in AI-assisted operations, MLOps, and cloud-native AI platforms
- Available for DevOps consulting, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes/OpenShift, and CI/CD automation work
